#!/bin/bash

pass=0; fail=0

  po=$("$EXE" "$@" 2>/tmp/pe); pc=$?; pe=$(cat /tmp/pe)
  no=$(node /output/test6.mjs "$@" 2>/tmp/ne); nc=$?; ne=$(cat /tmp/ne)
  # normalize prog name differences in diagnostics

  po_n=${po//test6_executable/PROG}; no_n=${no//test6.mjs/PROG}
